# CONSTRUCTED INPUT, NOT A CAPTURE. No EC was read to make this file; every
# byte below was written by hand. See ../README.md.
# Shape: `ecrw.py dump 0x0700 0x0100` as §3's step 0 takes it, one 16-byte row
# per line, for the a0 block's before dump. 0x0751 reads 0x10 here, the mode
# the block starts in; the companion after dump differs only in the four
# addresses the three CSVs record moving. The bytes §4.1-§4.3 name sit where
# a real read has them, and every value here is invented. Not a prediction
# that a real page looks like this.
